relationships.subject: dimethyl fumarate
relationships.evidence_quote: use chemoproteomics to identify C298 of NEK7 as a covalent target of the drug dimethyl fumarate, demonstrating that this residue is druggable and functionally required for the NLRP3-NEK7 interaction

key_findings: Commentary: dimethyl fumarate covalently modifies NEK7 C298, disrupting NLRP3-NEK7 interaction and inflammasome activation.
